title: Learning response-aware patient dynamics for respiratory support
abstract: arXiv:2609.32782v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Respiratory support can shape the short-term physiological trajectory of critically ill patients, but patients receiving the same intervention may follow different physiological trajectories. Clinical patient dynamics models typically predict future states from recent physiology and recorded interventions, while physiological change is mainly represented through the predicted future state. We propose a response-aware patient dynamics model that explicitly represents physiological change during autoregressive state updating. The model decomposes predicted physiological change into state-dependent baseline dynamics and respiratory-support-associated deviations, with room air providing a reference for the decomposition. We provide a formal analysis of this reference-anchored formulation. A response pathway encodes the predicted physiological change and uses it to update the latent patient state across the forecast horizon. Across ICU co

translated_title: 面向呼吸支持的响应感知患者动力学学习
translated_abstract: 呼吸支持能够塑造危重症患者的短期生理轨迹，但接受相同干预措施的患者可能遵循不同的生理轨迹。临床患者动力学模型通常基于近期生理状态和记录的干预措施来预测未来状态，而生理变化主要通过预测的未来状态来表示。我们提出了一种响应感知的患者动力学模型，该模型在自回归状态更新过程中显式表示生理变化。该模型将预测的生理变化分解为依赖于状态的基线动力学和与呼吸支持相关的偏差，并以室内空气（room air）作为该分解的参考基准。我们对这种基于参考锚定的公式化方法进行了形式化分析。响应通路对预测的生理变化进行编码，并在整个预测时间范围内利用它来更新潜在的患者状态。在ICU……
tldr: 提出了一种响应感知的患者动力学模型，将预测的生理变化显式分解为状态依赖的基线动力学和呼吸支持相关的偏差，并以室内空气作为参考基准，从而更好地建模呼吸支持对危重患者短期生理轨迹的个体化影响。
en_tdlr: We propose a response-aware patient dynamics model that explicitly decomposes predicted physiological change into state-dependent baseline dynamics and respiratory-support-associated deviations, anchored by room air as a reference, to better capture how respiratory support shapes individual patients' short-term physiological trajectories in the ICU.
